rules: Read BASE_CONTEXT.md + PROJECT_CONTEXT.md at the start of every session
Read API_CONTRACTS.md before calling any backend endpoint
Read WS_PROTOCOL.md before wiring any Socket.IO event
Check UNIMPLEMENTED tags in WS_PROTOCOL.md before subscribing to new events
Update UI_STATE.md when any context, hook, or component state shape changes
Update PORTAL_CAPABILITIES.md frontend column when feature status changes
Append to PROJECT_CONTEXT.md file change log after every change
Append to SESSION_LOG.md before ending every session
Never store access token in localStorage or sessionStorage
